cards.text: The word of Samuel, the LORD's prophet, comes to all Israel. Now Israel marches out to battle the Philistines, camping at Ebenezer while the Philistines camp at Aphek. Two armies, two camps, and me over here so nervous I'm hiding behind my own mustache.

cards.question: The armies line up and the battle spreads. True or false: in this first battle, Israel defeats the Philistines.

cards.text: The Philistines strike down about four thousand men. Back at camp, the elders of Israel ask, 'Why has the LORD brought defeat on us before the Philistines today?'

cards.question: After losing to the Philistines, the elders of Israel come up with a plan. What is it?

answers.text: Ask Samuel to pray for them

cards.question: True or false: the elders want the ark of the covenant to go with them so it can save them from the hand of their enemies.

cards.text: So the people send men to Shiloh, and they bring back the ark of the covenant of the LORD of Hosts, who sits enthroned between the cherubim.

cards.question: Two men are there with the ark of the covenant: the two sons of Eli, the priest at Shiloh. What are their names?

cards.text: And here it comes, friend. The ark of the covenant of the LORD enters the camp.

cards.question: True or false: when the ark enters Israel's camp, the Israelites shout so loud the ground shakes.

cards.text: Ruby, one of my cookie cutter kids, was a bell and the loudest voice in the Millers' kitchen, and even SHE never shook the ground. Over in their camp, the Philistines hear it and ask, 'What is this loud shouting in the camp of the Hebrews?'

cards.question: When they realize the ark of the LORD has entered Israel's camp, the Philistines are ___.

cards.text: 'The gods have entered their camp!' they say, and then they bring up some old news about these gods. Friend, it is NOT good news for them.

cards.question: The Philistines say, 'These are the gods who struck the ___ with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.'
Scared as they are of the ark in Israel's camp, what do the Philistines tell each other?

answers.text: Send gifts and ask for peace

cards.text: And they give each other the reason: 'Otherwise, you will serve the Hebrews just as they served you.' Friend, that's a better pep talk than I EVER got from the dead batteries I shared a junk drawer with.

cards.question: So the Philistines fight. How does this second battle go for Israel?

answers.text: Israel is defeated and thirty thousand fall
Israel wins and the Philistines flee
Neither side wins and they make peace

cards.question: Israel brought the ark of God into battle hoping it would save them. What happens to the ark?

answers.text: It is destroyed in the battle

cards.question: True or false: Eli's sons, Hophni and Phinehas, make it out of the battle alive.

cards.text: That same day, a man from the tribe of Benjamin runs from the battle line all the way to Shiloh, clothes torn and dirt on his head. Friend, I get winded hopping across my own bakery, and this man runs the WHOLE way.
When he arrives, there's Eli, sitting on his chair beside the road. Watching.

cards.question: Eli sits beside the road watching, because his heart trembles for the ___ of God.
True or false: when the man from the battle enters Shiloh to give his report, the whole city cries out.
The whole city of Shiloh cries out, and Eli hears it. What does Eli do?

answers.text: He asks what the commotion is
He gets up and runs to the gate
He sends for Samuel to come

cards.text: The man hurries over to Eli, who is ninety-eight years old now and can't see.
The man tells Eli he has just come from the battle and fled from there today. Friend, I spent years in a junk drawer holding my breath every time it opened, and I'm holding it right now.

cards.question: Eli asks the man from the battle, 'What happened, my son?' What news does the messenger give him?

answers.text: Israel fled and his sons died and the ark was taken
Israel won but both of his sons were badly hurt
The army fled but the ark is safe in the camp

cards.question: True or false: Eli falls backward from his chair as soon as the messenger mentions his two sons.

cards.text: As soon as the ark of God is mentioned, Eli falls backward from his chair by the city gate, and being old and heavy, he breaks his neck and dies. He had judged Israel forty years.

Now Eli's daughter-in-law, the wife of Phinehas, is pregnant and about to give birth. Then the news reaches her, and friend, it's all of it at once: the ark captured, her father-in-law and her husband dead.

cards.question: When the wife of Phinehas hears the news, what happens to her?

answers.text: She runs out to the city gate
She leaves Shiloh that same night

cards.text: She is dying. The women attending her say, 'Do not be afraid, for you have given birth to a son!'

cards.question: True or false: the wife of Phinehas pays attention to what the women attending her say.
The wife of Phinehas names her baby boy Ichabod. What does she say as she names him?

answers.text: The glory has departed from Israel
The LORD has remembered His people
God has heard the cry of Israel

cards.text: That line again: 'The glory has departed from Israel,' she said, 'for the ark of God has been captured.' That's a heavy one, friend, but keep your apron on, because this story is not done yet.
